# konnect_metering_subscription (Resource)

MeteringSubscription Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_metering_subscription" "my_meteringsubscription" {
  billing_anchor  = "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z"
  cost_basis_mode = "dynamic"
  custom_plan = {
    billing_cadence = "P1Y"
    currency        = "USD"
    description     = "...my_description..."
    labels = {
      key = "value"
    }
    name = "...my_name..."
    phases = [
      {
        description = "...my_description..."
        duration    = "P1Y"
        key         = "resource_key"
        labels = {
          key = "value"
        }
        name = "...my_name..."
        rate_cards = [
          {
            billing_cadence = "P1Y"
            commitments = {
              maximum_amount = "...my_maximum_amount..."
              minimum_amount = "...my_minimum_amount..."
            }
            currency    = "USD"
            description = "...my_description..."
            discounts = {
              percentage = 32.25
              usage      = "...my_usage..."
            }
            entitlement = {
              boolean = {
                # ...
              }
            }
            feature = {
              id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
            }
            key = "resource_key"
            labels = {
              key = "value"
            }
            name         = "...my_name..."
            payment_term = "in_arrears"
            price = {
              flat = {
                amount = "...my_amount..."
              }
            }
            tax_config = {
              behavior = "inclusive"
              code = {
                id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
              }
            }
            unit_config = {
              conversion_factor = "...my_conversion_factor..."
              display_unit      = "...my_display_unit..."
              operation         = "multiply"
              precision         = 0
              rounding          = "none"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
    pro_rating_enabled = true
  }
  customer = {
    id  = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
    key = "019ae40f-4258-7f15-9491-842f42a7d6ac"
  }
  labels = {
    key = "value"
  }
  plan = {
    id      = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
    key     = "resource_key"
    version = 9
  }
  settlement_mode = "credit_then_invoice"
  starting_phase  = "...my_starting_phase..."
  timing          = "immediate"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `customer` (Attributes) The customer to create the subscription for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer))

### Optional

- `billing_anchor` (String) A billing anchor is the fixed point in time that determines the subscription's
recurring billing cycle. It affects when charges occur and how prorations are
calculated. Common anchors:

- Calendar month (1st of each month): `2025-01-01T00:00:00Z`
- Subscription anniversary (day customer signed up)
- Custom date (customer-specified day)

If not provided, the subscription will be created with the subscription's
creation time as the billing anchor.
- `cost_basis_mode` (String) Controls how custom-currency cost bases are selected for the subscription. possible known values include one of ["dynamic", "pinned"]; Default: "dynamic"
- `custom_plan` (Attributes) An inline plan definition to create the subscription from, without referencing a
published plan.

Exactly one of `plan` or `custom_plan` must be provided. The subscription is not
linked to a persisted plan, so the response omits the `plan` reference. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan))
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
- `plan` (Attributes) A reference to a published plan the subscription is created from.

Exactly one of `plan` or `custom_plan` must be provided. Use `plan` to base the
subscription on an existing published plan; use `custom_plan` to define the plan
inline. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plan))
- `settlement_mode` (String) Settlement mode for billing.

Values:

- `credit_then_invoice`: Credits are applied first, then any remainder is
invoiced.
- `credit_only`: Usage is settled exclusively against credits.
possible known values include one of ["credit_then_invoice", "credit_only"]
- `starting_phase` (String) The key of the phase to start the subscription in. If not provided, the
subscription starts in the first phase of the plan.

Only applies when creating from a published `plan`; custom plans define their
own phases inline.
- `timing` (String) Subscription edit timing. Use `immediate` to apply changes right away, or
`next_billing_cycle` to apply them at the start of the next billing cycle.
Alternatively, provide an ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g.
`2025-01-15T00:00:00Z`) to schedule the changes for a specific date and time.

### Read-Only

- `active_from` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of when the subscription became (or will
become) active.
- `active_to` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of when the subscription stops being
active. Open-ended when not set.
- `billing_cadence` (String) The billing cadence of the subscription in ISO-8601 duration format. Defines how
often the customer is billed. Examples: `P1M` (monthly), `P3M` (quarterly),
`P1Y` (annually).
- `cost_basis_pins` (Attributes List) Cost bases pinned to custom-currency pairs for this subscription. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cost_basis_pins))
- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `current_period` (Attributes) The current aligned billing period. Present only when the subscription is active
and aligned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current_period))
- `customer_id` (String) The customer ID of the subscription.
- `deleted_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity deletion date.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the subscription.
- `id` (String) ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier).
- `invoice_currency` (String) The fiat currency in which the subscription is invoiced.
- `name` (String) Display name of the subscription. Defaults to the plan name when the
subscription is created from a plan.
- `phases` (Attributes List) The phases of the subscription in chronological order. A phase groups the rate
cards that are in effect for a segment of the subscription's lifetime. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases))
- `plan_id` (String, Deprecated) The plan ID of the subscription. Set if subscription is created from a plan.
- `pro_rating_config` (Attributes) The pro-rating configuration of the subscription. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pro_rating_config))
- `status` (String) The status of the subscription.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_plan.phases.rate_cards`

Required:

- `key` (String) A key is a unique string that is used to identify a resource.
- `name` (String) Display name of the resource.

Between 1 and 256 characters.
- `price` (Attributes) The price of the rate card. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--price))

Optional:

- `billing_cadence` (String) The billing cadence of the rate card. When null, the charge is one-time
(non-recurring). Only valid for flat prices.
- `commitments` (Attributes) Spend commitments for this rate card. Only applicable to usage-based prices
(unit, graduated, volume). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--commitments))
- `currency` (String) Overrides the containing plan or add-on currency for this rate card. When
omitted, the containing resource currency applies.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the resource.

Maximum 1024 characters.
- `discounts` (Attributes) The discounts of the rate card. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--discounts))
- `entitlement` (Attributes) The entitlement template granted to subscribers of a plan or addon containing
this rate card. Requires `feature` to be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--entitlement))
- `feature` (Attributes) The feature associated with the rate card. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--feature))
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
- `payment_term` (String) The payment term of the rate card. In advance payment term can only be used for
flat prices.
possible known values include one of ["in_advance", "in_arrears"]; Default: "in_arrears"
- `tax_config` (Attributes) The tax config of the rate card. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--tax_config))
- `unit_config` (Attributes) Unit conversion configuration for the rate card.

Synthesized on read for plans authored with v1 dynamic or package prices:
dynamic prices map to a unit price with a multiply unit config, and package
prices map to a unit price with a divide unit config.

Accepted on create and update only when the UnitConfig feature is enabled on the
deployment; otherwise rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--unit_config))

<a id="nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_plan.phases.rate_cards.price`

Optional:

- `flat` (Attributes) Flat price. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--price--flat))
- `free` (Attributes) Free price. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--price--free))
- `graduated` (Attributes) Graduated tiered price.

Each tier's rate applies only to the usage within that tier. Pricing can change
as cumulative usage crosses tier boundaries.

When UnitConfig is present on the containing resource, tier boundaries
(up_to_amount) are expressed in converted billing units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--price--graduated))
- `unit` (Attributes) Unit price.

Charges a fixed rate per billing unit. When UnitConfig is present on the object,
billing units are the converted quantities (e.g. GB instead of bytes). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--price--unit))
- `volume` (Attributes) Volume tiered price.

The maximum quantity within a period determines the per-unit price for all units
in that period.

When UnitConfig is present on the containing resource, tier boundaries
(up_to_amount) are expressed in converted billing units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--price--volume))

### Nested Schema for `custom_plan.phases.rate_cards.entitlement.metered`

Optional:

- `is_soft_limit` (Boolean) If soft limit is true, the subject can use the feature even if the entitlement
is exhausted; access remains granted.
Default: false
- `limit` (Number) The amount of usage granted each usage period, in the feature's unit. Usage is
counted against this allowance and the balance resets every usage period. When
`is_soft_limit` is true the subject keeps access after the limit is reached;
otherwise access is denied once the allowance is exhausted.
- `usage_period` (String) The reset interval of the metered entitlement in ISO8601 format. Defaults to the
billing cadence of the rate card.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--tax_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_plan.phases.rate_cards.tax_config`

Optional:

- `behavior` (String) Tax behavior.

This enum is used to specify whether tax is included in the price or excluded
from the price. If not specified, the billing profile is used to determine the
tax behavior. If not specified in the billing profile, the provider's default
behavior is used.
possible known values include one of ["inclusive", "exclusive"]
- `code` (Attributes) Tax code applied to the invoice line item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--tax_config--code))

<a id="nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--tax_config--code"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_plan.phases.rate_cards.tax_config.code`

Required:

<a id="nestedatt--custom_plan--phases--rate_cards--unit_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_plan.phases.rate_cards.unit_config`

Required:

- `conversion_factor` (String) The factor used in the conversion operation.

- For `divide`: `converted = raw / conversionFactor`.
- For `multiply`: `converted = raw × conversionFactor`.

Must be a positive non-zero value.
- `operation` (String) The arithmetic operation to apply to the raw metered quantity. possible known values include one of ["divide", "multiply"]

Optional:

- `display_unit` (String) A human-readable label for the converted unit shown on invoices and in the
customer portal (e.g., "GB", "hours", "M tokens").

Optional. When omitted, no unit label is rendered.
- `precision` (Number) The number of decimal places to retain after rounding.

Only meaningful when rounding is not "none". Defaults to 0 (round to whole
numbers).
Default: 0
- `rounding` (String) The rounding mode applied to the converted quantity for invoicing.

Defaults to none (no rounding). Entitlement checks always use the precise
(unrounded) value.
possible known values include one of ["ceiling", "floor", "half_up", "none"]; Default: "none"

dynamic prices map to a unit price with a multiply unit config, and package
prices map to a unit price with a divide unit config.

Accepted on create and update only when the UnitConfig feature is enabled on the
deployment; otherwise rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--unit_config))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--commitments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.commitments`

Read-Only:

- `maximum_amount` (String) The customer is limited to spend at most the amount.
- `minimum_amount` (String) The customer is committed to spend at least the amount.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--discounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.discounts`

Read-Only:

- `percentage` (Number) Percentage discount applied to the price (0–100).
- `usage` (String) Number of usage units granted free before billing starts. Only applies to
usage-based lines (not flat fees). Usage is treated as zero until this amount is
exhausted.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--entitlement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.entitlement`

Read-Only:

- `boolean` (Attributes) The entitlement template of a boolean entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--entitlement--boolean))
- `metered` (Attributes) The entitlement template of a metered entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--entitlement--metered))
- `static` (Attributes) The entitlement template of a static entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--entitlement--static))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--entitlement--boolean"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.entitlement.boolean`


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--entitlement--metered"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.entitlement.metered`

Read-Only:

- `is_soft_limit` (Boolean) If soft limit is true, the subject can use the feature even if the entitlement
is exhausted; access remains granted.
Default: false
- `limit` (Number) The amount of usage granted each usage period, in the feature's unit. Usage is
counted against this allowance and the balance resets every usage period. When
`is_soft_limit` is true the subject keeps access after the limit is reached;
otherwise access is denied once the allowance is exhausted.
- `usage_period` (String) The reset interval of the metered entitlement in ISO8601 format. Defaults to the
billing cadence of the rate card.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--entitlement--static"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.entitlement.static`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String) The entitlement config as a JSON object. Returned when checking entitlement
access; useful for configuring fine-grained access settings implemented in your
own system.
Parsed as JSON.



<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--feature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.feature`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier).


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price`

Read-Only:

- `flat` (Attributes) Flat price. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--flat))
- `free` (Attributes) Free price. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--free))
- `graduated` (Attributes) Graduated tiered price.

Each tier's rate applies only to the usage within that tier. Pricing can change
as cumulative usage crosses tier boundaries.

When UnitConfig is present on the containing resource, tier boundaries
(up_to_amount) are expressed in converted billing units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated))
- `unit` (Attributes) Unit price.

Charges a fixed rate per billing unit. When UnitConfig is present on the object,
billing units are the converted quantities (e.g. GB instead of bytes). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--unit))
- `volume` (Attributes) Volume tiered price.

The maximum quantity within a period determines the per-unit price for all units
in that period.

When UnitConfig is present on the containing resource, tier boundaries
(up_to_amount) are expressed in converted billing units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--flat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.flat`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount of the flat price.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--free"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.free`


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.graduated`

Read-Only:

- `tiers` (Attributes List) The tiers of the graduated price. At least one tier is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated--tiers))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.graduated.tiers`

Read-Only:

- `flat_price` (Attributes) The flat price component of the tier. Charged once when the tier is entered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated--tiers--flat_price))
- `unit_price` (Attributes) The unit price component of the tier. Charged per billing unit within the tier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated--tiers--unit_price))
- `up_to_amount` (String) Up to and including this quantity will be contained in the tier. If undefined,
the tier is open-ended (the last tier).

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated--tiers--flat_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.graduated.tiers.flat_price`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount of the flat price.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--graduated--tiers--unit_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.graduated.tiers.unit_price`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount of the unit price.




<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--unit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.unit`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount of the unit price.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.volume`

Read-Only:

- `tiers` (Attributes List) The tiers of the volume price. At least one tier is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume--tiers))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.volume.tiers`

Read-Only:

- `flat_price` (Attributes) The flat price component of the tier. Charged once when the tier is entered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume--tiers--flat_price))
- `unit_price` (Attributes) The unit price component of the tier. Charged per billing unit within the tier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume--tiers--unit_price))
- `up_to_amount` (String) Up to and including this quantity will be contained in the tier. If undefined,
the tier is open-ended (the last tier).

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume--tiers--flat_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.volume.tiers.flat_price`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount of the flat price.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--price--volume--tiers--unit_price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.price.volume.tiers.unit_price`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount of the unit price.





<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--tax_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.tax_config`

Read-Only:

- `behavior` (String) Tax behavior.

This enum is used to specify whether tax is included in the price or excluded
from the price. If not specified, the billing profile is used to determine the
tax behavior. If not specified in the billing profile, the provider's default
behavior is used.
- `code` (Attributes) Tax code applied to the invoice line item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--tax_config--code))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--tax_config--code"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.tax_config.code`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier).



<a id="nestedatt--phases--items--rate_card--unit_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.items.rate_card.unit_config`

Read-Only:

- `conversion_factor` (String) The factor used in the conversion operation.

- For `divide`: `converted = raw / conversionFactor`.
- For `multiply`: `converted = raw × conversionFactor`.

Must be a positive non-zero value.
- `display_unit` (String) A human-readable label for the converted unit shown on invoices and in the
customer portal (e.g., "GB", "hours", "M tokens").

Optional. When omitted, no unit label is rendered.
- `operation` (String) The arithmetic operation to apply to the raw metered quantity.
- `precision` (Number) The number of decimal places to retain after rounding.

Only meaningful when rounding is not "none". Defaults to 0 (round to whole
numbers).
Default: 0
- `rounding` (String) The rounding mode applied to the converted quantity for invoicing.

Defaults to none (no rounding). Entitlement checks always use the precise
(unrounded) value.
Default: "none"





<a id="nestedatt--pro_rating_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pro_rating_config`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether pro-rating is enabled.
- `mode` (String) How pro-rating is calculated when enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_metering_subscription.my_konnect_metering_subscription
  id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_metering_subscription.my_konnect_metering_subscription "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
```
